e.title: BIND Standard
e.summary: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）：保险互操作开放标准——经纪/承保/再保间机器可读数据交换
e.body: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）是保险行业开放数据互操作标准（bind-standard.org）：定义一套通用的资源类型与数据结构，让经纪人、保险公司、MGA、TPA、再保人与供应商以一致、机器可读的格式交换信息——一次集成、处处可用。对 RIAA：理解保险价值链数据交换的现代标准（API 驱动的互操作）。与 [[openidl]]（openIDS）、[[pcdm]]（财产险数据模型）同属保险数据标准生态。关联 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]。

e.summary_en: BIND (Business Insurance Normalized Data): open interoperability standard for insurance — machine-readable exchange between brokers/carriers/reinsurers
e.summary_hk: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）：保險互操作開放標準——經紀/承保/再保間機器可讀數據交換
e.body_en: BIND (Business Insurance Normalized Data) is an open data interoperability standard for insurance (bind-standard.org): it defines a common set of resource types and data structures enabling brokers, carriers, MGAs, TPAs, reinsurers and vendors to exchange information in a consistent, machine-readable format — integrate once, use everywhere. For RIAA: understanding the modern standard for data exchange across the insurance value chain (API-driven interoperability). With [[openidl]] (openIDS) and [[pcdm]] (property-casualty data model) it belongs to the insurance data-standards ecosystem. Related: [[actuarial-ontology]], [[insurance-ai-mcp]].
e.body_hk: BIND（Business Insurance Normalized Data）是保險行業開放數據互操作標準（bind-standard.org）：定義一套通用的資源類型與數據結構，讓經紀人、保險公司、MGA、TPA、再保人與供應商以一致、機器可讀的格式交換信息——一次集成、處處可用。對 RIAA：理解保險價值鏈數據交換的現代標準（API 驅動的互操作）。與 [[openidl]]（openIDS）、[[pcdm]]（財產險數據模型）同屬保險數據標準生態。關聯 [[actuarial-ontology]]、[[insurance-ai-mcp]]。
